body: Instead of creating a new function, the signal should call `filter_bar->apply()` directly.
Any reason for those conditionals to be separated? It seems to only indent an already very indented block of code.

to be able to filter different columns at a time
`class:animation object:godette`
No, I mean why they are two different blocks. You could've just used a `&&`, and and a line break if you really want to separate them.

```suggestion
		bool filter_is_col = (filter_str.get_slice_count(":") == 2); // Filter is of the type 'col_name:match' (replacing spaces with '_').
```
Also, this is weirdly worded. Did you mean "of type"?
Those variables don't need to be in uppercase. Also, shouldn't they be outside of this loop?
This change is part of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/123708, we should address it there instead.
